summary: Browse Zotero collections, read metadata and indexed paper text, and keep papers available offline.
release_notes: Line up a table's columns under the headings that name them, typeset numbered equations, set figures apart from the prose, and carry a document's mathematics all the way through instead of stopping early.

steps.text: Create a dedicated Zotero API key with read-only access to your personal library.
Copy the numeric user ID shown on the Zotero API key settings page. Zotero Reader asks for it on first launch.
Install the API key on your Kobo under the exact secret name zotero.
Launch Zotero Reader, enter the numeric user ID, and select a collection.
Direct mode reads indexed text. Structured PDF layout, tables, figures, formulas, and OCR require the optional self-hosted conversion service.

user: Somebody whose papers live in Zotero.
job: Browse your Zotero collections and read your papers on e-ink.
offline: Papers already kept and their indexed text work without the network; browsing collections does not.
